note: MWScript compiled by the builder (tools/prepare_mwscript.py, docs/MWSCRIPT_BYTECODE.md). Every content setting of the compiled scripts lives here as the default.

handwritten.reason: The opening (the prison ship, the census office and the papers) is carried today by the engine's hand-written story rules (engine/aga/src/aw_opening.c, aw_intro.c). Its scripts are compiled and measured but not run, so nothing happens twice; each comes off this list when its hand-written rule is replaced by the compiled script. Off the list (CENSUS-INTRO-SCRIPTS-62): the census office's door scripts CharGenDoorEnterCaptain, CharGenDoorExit, CharGenDoorExitCaptain; the courtyard's fatigue barrel CharGenFatigueBarrel; the hall door guard CharGenDoorGuardTalker (his lines, the hall door's Unlock); the clerk CharGenClassNPC (his lines, the class, birth and review windows, the papers shown); the papers CharGenStatsSheet and the courtyard ring CharGen_ring_keley (both read OnPCAdd, which the engine sets when the item enters the inventory). The engine holds every script it runs instead of the old path while aw_census_legacy is 1 (aw_mwhost.c census_scripts).

activation.note: A placed script runs while the player is within this many game units of it (1.5 exterior cells; the original runs the scripts of the 3 by 3 cells around the player). Interior scripts run while their room is loaded.

budget.note: Opcodes the interpreter may execute per frame across all scripts (round robin), and per script run (a guard against a loop that never ends).
